must_read.title: Three-Dimensional Condylar Subtyping and Its Association With Obstructive Sleep Apnea Severity in Adults: Implication for Craniofacial Skeletal Phenotype
must_read.title_zh: 成人三维髁突分型及其与阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停严重程度的关联：对颅面骨骼表型的启示
must_read.one_line: 以髁突吸收+皮质重建两轴分型，发现重度吸收组AHI及CSP特征显著更高
must_read.so_what: 髁突形态学与OSA关联，q2间接相关；分型框架可迁移至种植体周炎骨吸收表型分析
must_read.caution: 回顾性设计，样本量未披露，因果推断能力弱
must_read.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the association between three-dimensional (3D) condylar resorption pattern and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) severity in adults, and to explore its structural implications within the craniofacial skeletal phenotype (CSP) framework. METHODS: Condylar morphology was classified using a two-axis system integrating the degree of resorption and cortical remodelling pattern. Patients were grouped into no resorption (NR), adaptive remodelling (AR), and severe resorption (SR) categories. Dentoskeletal, temporomandibular joint (TMJ), and polysomnographic variables were compared among groups. Multivariable regression analyses were adjusted for age, sex, and body mass index, and hierarchical regression was used to examine the contribution of condylar grouping beyond CSP. RESULTS: Severe condylar resorption was identified in 23.9% of the sample and was more prevalent (54.0%) in patients with CSP features. The SR group demonstrated greater skeletal discrepancy and higher apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), respiratory disturbance index (RDI), and arousal index (ArI) values (all, p < 0.05). After adjustment for age, sex, and body mass index and false discovery rate correction, SR remained significantly associated with higher AHI, RDI, and ArI, whereas TMJ pain history, condylar angulation, and oxygenation-related indices showed no significant associations. In hierarchical models, the overall incremental contribution of condylar grouping beyond CSP was not significant after multiple-testing correction; however, SR remained significantly associated with higher AHI and RDI after additional adjustment for CSP (both, FDR-adjusted p = 0.045). CONCLUSIONS: Severe condylar resorption was associated with greater skeletal discrepancy and higher OSA burden. Three-dimensional TMJ assessment may complement conventional skeletal phenotyping in adult OSA.

deep.title_zh: 成人三维髁突分型及其与阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停严重程度的关联：对颅面骨骼表型的启示
deep.one_sentence: 严重髁突侵蚀与OSA严重度正相关（AHI/RDI/ArI均升高），但这种关联在颅面骨骼表型框架下增量贡献有限，因果关系…
deep.question: 髁突的三维侵蚀-重建模式是OSA的因果标志物，还是OSA驱动的继发性骨重塑反应？它能否独立于颅面骨骼表型预测OSA严重度？
deep.design: 横断面研究，按髁突侵蚀程度和皮质重建模式分三组（NR/AR/SR），比较各组牙颌骨骼、TMJ指标及多导睡眠图参数，行多变量回归与分层回归分析。

findings.claim: 严重髁突侵蚀（SR）在整体样本中占比约四分之一，在具有颅面骨骼表型（CSP）特征的患者中显著更高。
SR组的OSA客观严重度指标（AHI、RDI、ArI）均显著高于其他组。
调整混杂后SR仍独立关联OSA严重度，但TMJ疼痛史、髁突角度和氧合指标无显著关联。
findings.evidence: 经年龄、性别、BMI及FDR校正后SR与AHI、RDI、ArI显著相关；TMJ疼痛史、髁突角度、氧合指标均无显著关联

findings.claim: 髁突分组对CSP框架的增量解释力经多重检验校正后不显著，但SR在额外调整CSP后仍与AHI、RDI显著相关。
findings.evidence: 分层回归整体增量贡献不显著（FDR校正后）；SR单独调整CSP后仍显著（AHI和RDI，FDR-adjusted p=0.045）

deep.effect: 未报告具体效应量及置信区间
deep.relation: q2——本研究提供了「局部骨重塑与全身疾病关联」的一个新观察维度：髁突侵蚀（可能涉及慢性炎症/机械应激）与OSA严重度相关，提示TMJ局部病理可能参与OSA的骨性表型形成，但因果方向未明，属于对q2中「通路可验证性」的间接支持而非直接机制证据。
deep.why: 它挑战了OSA研究中长期聚焦于上气道软组织塌陷的主流范式，将髁突三维形态纳入颅面骨骼表型框架，提出OSA可能驱动TMJ继发性骨重塑（而非仅是骨骼发育异常导致OSA）。分层回归结果提醒读者：髁突分型的临床增量价值有限，需在CSP框架下解读。
limitations: 横断面设计，无法确定髁突侵蚀是OSA的原因还是后果，因果推断缺失。
样本来源、纳入排除标准、是否单中心均未说明，选择偏倚风险未知。
多重检验校正后整体增量贡献不显著，仅SR在额外调整后保留显著性（p=0.045），存在假阳性风险。
deep.transferable: ① 两轴髁突分类系统（侵蚀程度+皮质重建模式）可用于其他TMJ-系统性疾病关联研究；② 分层回归策略（先加CSP再加髁突分组）可作为评估影像标志物增量价值的参考框架；③ FDR校正+分层回归的组合方法值得在多组学/多表型研究中借鉴。
followups: 该研究的样本量、纳入排除标准和数据来源（单中心/多中心）是什么？能否获取原始数据复现分层回归？
髁突侵蚀的影像学判读者间一致性（Kappa值）是否报告？如果未报告，分类系统的主观性会如何影响结果可靠性？
SR组与NR/AR组在骨骼差异的具体维度（如ANB角、SNA、SNB）上有何差异？OSA与髁突侵蚀的关联是否仅由特定的颅面骨骼表型驱动？

must_reads.title: Effect of income trajectory on dental service utilization patterns during the transition from childhood to adolescence: a 10-year cohort study
must_reads.title_zh: 收入轨迹对从儿童期到青春期过渡期牙科服务利用模式的影响：一项10年队列研究
must_reads.one_line: 10年队列用群组轨迹模型+Blinder-Oaxaca分解，发现收入轨迹独立于教育/肤色影响牙科服务利用。
must_reads.so_what: 方法学可迁移：若研究种植并发症的社会决定因素，群组轨迹建模值得借鉴。
must_reads.caution: 巴西单地区队列，外部推广性有限。
must_reads.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to investigate the influence of income trajectories on dental service utilization patterns during the transition from childhood to adolescence in a Southern Brazilian birth cohort. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Children were followed over 13 years (T1, T2, and T3). Income trajectories (stable low/decreasing vs. stable high/increasing) were identified using group-based trajectory modeling based on finite mixture models. Outcomes included frequency of dental visits and reason for the last visit (preventive vs. curative). Socioeconomic disparities were explored using the non-linear Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition method. RESULTS: From 639 children at baseline (T1), 449 were followed at T2 and 429 at T3 (67.1% retention). Adolescents from stable high or increasing-income trajectories had a lower prevalence of dental visits for curative reasons (OR = 0.29; 95% CI 0.09-0.90). Decomposition analysis showed that maternal education (9%) and skin color (12.5%) explained only a small portion of these inequalities, suggesting an independent effect of income over time. CONCLUSIONS: Individuals with increasing income were less likely to use dental services for curative purposes, regardless of race, dental caries, and maternal education, highlighting the impact of economic stability on oral health behaviors. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: Income trajectories over time influence the pattern of dental service utilization in adolescence. Identifying individuals in disadvantaged socioeconomic trajectories may support targeted preventive strategies and improve access to care.

deep.title_zh: 收入轨迹对从儿童期到青春期过渡期牙科服务利用模式的影响：一项10年队列研究
deep.one_sentence: 收入稳定或上升轨迹的青少年更少因治疗目的就诊，经济稳定性独立于种族与母亲教育影响口腔服务利用模式
deep.question: 家庭收入的时间轨迹（稳定高/上升 vs 稳定低/下降）能否独立解释青少年牙科服务利用从预防向治疗偏移的社经不平等？
deep.design: 巴西南部出生队列，3个时间点随访13年（T1-T3），基于有限混合模型识别收入轨迹组，非线形Blinder-Oaxaca分解社经差异
deep.sample_desc: 巴西南部出生队列，基线639名儿童，T2随访449人，T3随访429人，保留率67.1%

findings.claim: 高收入/上升收入轨迹显著降低治疗性就诊概率
findings.evidence: OR=0.29，95%CI 0.09-0.90，对照组为稳定低/下降收入组

findings.claim: 传统社经指标仅能解释极小比例的不平等
findings.evidence: 母亲教育解释9%，肤色解释12.5%，合计不足两成

findings.claim: 收入轨迹具有独立于种族、龋齿状态和母亲教育的效应
findings.evidence: 分解分析显示收入轨迹是主要驱动因素，非其他协变量混杂所致

deep.relation: q5间接相关：提供了'社经微环境塑造口腔健康行为'的证据链一环；若将q5的免疫微环境类比为'行为微环境'，此研究展示了外部环境轨迹如何编程宿主行为结局的方法学借鉴。与q4（材料编程宿主）有逻辑相似性——时间轨迹即'编程信号'。
deep.why: 它打破了'种牙不治疗''补牙才是预防'的简单社经归因，证明收入轨迹的动态变化本身具有独立因果效应，且传统静态指标（如某一时点收入）会严重低估不平等——方法学上教会研究者如何用轨迹模型替代横断面分类
limitations: 保留率67.1%，存在选择性流失偏倚，低社经群体可能更易失访
巴西单一国情，收入轨迹的阈值和效果未必外推至中国医保体系下的青少年
未报告具体收入轨迹分组的绝对人数与各组基线特征，无法判断模型分组稳定性
deep.transferable: Group-based trajectory modeling（GBTM）+ Blinder-Oaxaca分解的组合——可迁移到任何'动态暴露→结局'的队列分析，尤其适合研究种植体周炎进展中宿主免疫状态的时序演变与临床转归的关系
followups: GBTM轨迹分组的AIC/BIC及平均后验概率（APP）各是多少？分组是否稳健？
收入轨迹从哪个时间点（T1/T2/T3）开始显著分化？即关键窗口期在几岁？
预防性就诊与治疗性就诊的OR是否也呈现梯度效应，还是仅治疗性就诊受影响？

glossary.cn: 布林德-奥沙卡分解（社经差异归因方法）
治疗性就诊（以补救为目的）
预防性就诊（以检查/涂氟/窝沟封闭为目的）
有限混合模型（轨迹建模的统计基础）

scan.title: Influence of third molar eruption status on the biomechanical environment of the temporomandibular joint: An in silico evaluation
scan.title_zh: 第三磨牙萌出状态对TMJ生物力学影响的FEA评估
scan.one_line: 对7种第三磨牙状态做有限元分析，发现阻生/功能位均增加髁突负荷
scan.caution: 纯FEM计算模拟，无实验验证，研究者明确排斥此类方法
scan.abstract: Third molar (M3) may potentially cause occlusal interference, disrupt occlusal balance, alter temporomandibular joint (TMJ) loading, and impair the functional homeostasis of the stomatognathic system. This study conducted finite element method (FEM) on seven typical M3 conditions, analyzed its effects on occlusal and joint loading, and built an analytic biomechanical model to explore the regulatory mechanism of mandibular morphological parameters. Results revealed that (1) the presence of M3 would elevate TMJ functional load for all seven cases, in comparison to congenital absence case (control model [CM]). (2) Moreover, both occlusally functional (four erupted) and non-occluded (three impacted) cases of M3 presence could shift bite force to the posterior dentition and TMJ. (3) With constant masticatory muscle force, greater relative occlusal plane height (h) and length (L) would reduce TMJ loading. However, the load trends between dentition and TMJ could be reversed in consideration of periodontal ligament (PDL) negative feedback, wherein the load tendency is consistent with clinical data. In conclusion, the M3 presence would hinder the dispersion of occlusal forces in the stomatognathic system, and consequently aggravate stress environments in TMJ. The extraction of M3 could be potentially beneficial for alleviating the stress situation in TMJ due to the increase of relative occlusal plane height.

scan.title: Descending Necrotizing Mediastinitis After Thyroidectomy
scan.title_zh: 甲状腺切除术后继发降质性纵隔炎
scan.domain: 牙周炎通过哪些可验证的通…
scan.one_line: 两中心回顾3例甲状腺术后罕见纵隔感染病例，文献复习补充既往报道
scan.caution: n=3-5，回顾性病例系列，证据层级极低
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Thyroidectomy is a commonly performed endocrine procedure with generally low complication rates. Descending necrotizing mediastinitis (DNM) is an exceptionally rare but life-threatening complication resulting from cervical infections that spread into the mediastinum. DNM following thyroid surgery has been reported only rarely. METHODS: We analyzed retrospectively five patients who developed DNM following thyroid surgery between 2023 and 2025 at two tertiary centers. The patients' demographics, comorbidities, surgical procedures, clinical presentation, imaging, microbiology, treatment, complications, and outcomes were reviewed. The diagnosis was based on clinical and radiological evidence of cervicomediastinal infection, with operative confirmation in the four patients who underwent surgical drainage. A literature review was conducted using PubMed, MEDLINE, and Embase. RESULTS: The case series included four women and one man (age 35-68, mean 53.8 years). All patients had at least one comorbidity, including obesity, cardiovascular or respiratory disease, immune compromise, and chronic nicotine use. Surgical procedures included total thyroidectomy (n = 3) and hemithyroidectomy (n = 2). Symptoms developed 2-10 days postoperatively, including cervical pain, swelling, fever, dysphagia, dyspnea, tachycardia, and subcutaneous emphysema. Contrast-enhanced (CT) of the neck and chest demonstrated findings consistent with DNM in all patients, with operative confirmation in the four patients requiring surgical drainage. Microbiological analyses identified Streptococcus pyogenes in three patients and Streptococcus pneumoniae in one patient. Concomitant methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA) was isolated in one of the patients with S. pyogenes, while an additional patient had a positive rapid Group A Streptococcus test without confirmatory culture. Treatment included cervical drainage (n = 4), thoracic intervention (n = 2), tracheal repair (n = 1), and ICU admission (n = 4). Complications included acute kidney failure, septic shock, pleural/pericardial effusions, pulmonary embolism, and cardiac arrest. All patients survived with hospital stays ranging 7 to 42 days (median 21). Although the acute infectious process resolved in all patients, some required rehabilitation and one experienced long-term disability affecting daily activities and work cap

scan.title: Association between molar-incisor hypomineralization and developmental dental anomalies in U.S. children: a cross-sectional study
scan.title_zh: 磨牙-切牙釉质发育不全与儿童发育性牙齿异常的关联
scan.one_line: 159例横断面发现MIH患儿DDA发生率39.5% vs 13.7%，短根畸形和牛牙样结构风险显著升高。
scan.so_what: 方法学参考：校准 examiner + blinded radiographic reading …
scan.caution: n=159，横断面无法推断因果方向。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To compare the frequency of developmental dental anomalies (DDAs) in children with and without molar-incisor hypomineralization (MIH), and to evaluate whether any association is independent of demographic factors. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This comparative cross-sectional study included children aged 6-14 years with and without MIH. Demographic data were collected by structured maternal questionnaire. MIH was diagnosed by calibrated examiners using a validated MIH Index. DDAs were assessed on panoramic radiographs by a blinded examiner using predefined criteria. Group comparisons used Fisher's exact test (two-sided), and multivariable logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), adjusting for country of birth, sex, and ethnicity. RESULTS: In total, 159 children were enrolled. Any DDA was more frequent in the MIH group than in the non-MIH group (​39.5% vs. 13.7%; p < 0.001​). Short root anomaly (14.0% vs. 1.4%; p = 0.003) and taurodontism (7.4% vs. 0.0%; p = 0.031) were also more frequent with MIH, whereas microdontia of the maxillary lateral incisors was more frequent numerically but not significantly (5.8% vs. 0.0%; p = 0.063). MIH remained independently associated with any DDA in multivariable analysis (aOR = 4.52; 95% CI: 1.97-10.33; p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Children with MIH had greater odds of concurrent DDAs than children without MIH, most often short root anomaly. Individual anomaly estimates were imprecise owing to few events. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: Children with MIH may present with concurrent DDAs, highlighting the potential value of comprehensive clinical assessment and appropriate radiographic evaluation when clinically indicated.

scan.title: Prevalence and Risk Factors for Dental Anxiety and Dental Fear in Nigeria: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
scan.title_zh: 尼日利亚人群牙科焦虑流行率的系统评价与Meta分析
scan.one_line: 系统评价与Meta分析估计尼日利亚人群牙科焦虑 pooled prevalence 及相关危险因素。
scan.so_what: 仅背景，纯流调无机制价值。
scan.caution: 纳入研究以横断面为主，异质性难控制。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVE: In Nigeria, the burden of dental anxiety and dental fear (DFA) remains poorly characterized despite its possible contribution to poor dental service utilization and treatment avoidance. This study aimed to estimate the pooled prevalence of dental anxiety in Nigerian populations and identify associated risk factors. METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was registered in PROSPERO: (CRD420261373453). A search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, EBSCOhost, and African Journals Online from inception to March 2026. Studies were included if they were cross-sectional, cohort, or case-control studies conducted in Nigerian populations of any age that reported prevalence estimates of DFA using validated instruments. Two independent reviewers extracted data and assessed the risk of bias using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklists. The primary outcome was the pooled prevalence of dental anxiety, calculated using random-effects meta-analysis with the Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation. The associations between DFA and age, sex, and educational levels were also determined. Heterogeneity was assessed using I2 statistics. RESULTS: Of 237 records identified, 30 studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising 7920 participants. The pooled prevalence of DFA was 61% (95% CI: 41%-79%; I2 = 97%). Severe to extreme DFA prevalence was 18% (95% CI: 12%-27%). The pooled mean dental anxiety score was 11.9 (95% CI: 10.6-13.2). Females had higher DFA scores than males (mean difference 1.3, p = 0.0003) although the certainty of evidence was low. Participants under 30 years had higher scores than those 30 years and older (mean difference 1.6, p = 0.0002). Education level showed no significant association. Most studies (86.7%) had a moderate risk of bias. No publication bias was detected. CONCLUSION: Dental anxiety and dental fear affect approximately three-quarters of the Nigerian population, with a possible higher burden among females and younger adults. These findings highlight the possible value of routine anxiety screening and integration of behavioural management into Nigerian dental practice.

scan.title: Temporomandibular Disorders, Work Productivity, and Activity Impairment: A Cohort Study Using a Claims and Survey Database in Japan
scan.title_zh: 颞下颌关节紊乱对工作生产力影响的日本队列研究
scan.one_line: 570人claims+问卷3年队列用两阶段模型，发现TMD诊断与工作生产力受损正相关。
scan.caution: claims数据无法校正混杂（如压力、抑郁）。
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Temporomandibular disorders (TMDs) are prevalent musculoskeletal conditions worldwide. However, their societal and productivity burden remains poorly understood. OBJECTIVE: Using a claims and survey database, this 3-year cohort study investigated the association between TMD diagnosis and work productivity and activity impairment (WPAI) among Japanese workers. METHODS: We identified TMD diagnoses (exposure) using claims data and assessed the WPAI (outcome) using a validated questionnaire. A two-part model was used to examine the association between TMD diagnosis around the survey period and WPAI outcomes. The first part employed a logistic regression model to estimate the odds ratio (OR) and 95% confidence interval (CI) for impairments in WPAI outcomes. The second part utilized a generalized linear model with a gamma distribution and a log-link function to estimate the exponentiated coefficients (mean ratio) and 95% CI for the magnitude of impairment among those reporting impairment in WPAI outcomes. RESULTS: The analysis included 18 570 participants (mean age: 49.0 [standard deviation = 9.1] years; 65.7% male). After adjusting for all covariates, workers with TMD showed higher odds of impairment across all WPAI indicators than those without (OR: absenteeism, 1.31 [95% CI, 0.80-2.13]; presenteeism, 1.34 [0.97-1.85]; overall work impairment, 1.42 [1.03-1.96]; and activity impairment, 1.51 [1.10-2.08]). Among workers reporting any impairment in WPAI outcomes, TMD was not associated with WPAI severity. CONCLUSION: Workers with TMD diagnosis more often reported overall work and activity impairments. The observed association may inform future research on the impact of TMD on WPAI outcomes.

scan.title: Clinicopathological agreement following asynchronous remote and face-to-face oral medicine consultations: A retrospective comparative study
scan.title_zh: 远程与面诊口腔医学咨询的病理符合率比较
scan.one_line: 386例回顾性比较发现远程咨询后活检的完整/部分符合率92.1%，与面诊90.7%无显著差异。

scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate clinicopathological concordance between presumptive clinical diagnoses and histopathological findings following asynchronous remote and face-to-face oral medicine consultations, and to compare biopsy completion and clinical documentation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective comparative study included 386 adults for whom biopsy was recommended following asynchronous remote (n = 190) or face-to-face (n = 196) oral medicine consultation. Diagnostic concordance was assessed exclusively among patients who underwent biopsy (n = 302), using a three-level clinical classification (complete, partial, or discordant) and Cohen's kappa for agreement between coded diagnostic categories. Multivariable logistic regression evaluated associations between concordance and consultation modality, age, sex, and smoking status. Secondary outcomes included biopsy completion and smoking-status documentation. RESULTS: Among biopsied patients, complete or partial clinicopathological concordance was observed in 129/140 remote consultations (92.1%) and 147/162 face-to-face consultations (90.7%). Cohen's kappa was 0.812 for remote consultations and 0.691 for face-to-face consultations. Diagnostic category distributions differed significantly between groups (p < 0.001). Consultation modality was not independently associated with concordance (adjusted OR = 1.177, 95% CI 0.513-2.776; p = 0.702), whereas increasing age was associated with lower concordance (adjusted OR = 0.952 per year, 95% CI 0.915-0.992; p = 0.015). Biopsy completion was lower following remote consultation (140/190, 73.7% vs. 162/196, 82.7%; p = 0.033), as was smoking-status documentation (142/190, 74.7% vs. 175/196, 89.3%; p < 0.001). Eleven dysplastic and five malignant lesions were identified; one malignant lesion demonstrated clinically significant diagnostic discordance. CONCLUSIONS: Substantial clinicopathological agreement was observed in both consultation groups among patients who underwent biopsy. Differences in case mix and biopsy completion limit direct comparisons between consultation modalities. Asynchronous remote consultation may complement face-to-face oral medicine assessment, provided that appropriate clinical evaluation and follow-up are maintained. scan.title: The Relationship Between Occlusal Tactile Acuity, Bite Force and Tooth Wear
scan.title_zh: 咬合触觉敏锐度、咬合力与牙体磨损的关系
scan.one_line: 51例队列发现咬合力与总体牙磨损中度正相关，OTA与后牙磨损小负相关。
scan.so_what: 仅背景，不涉及免疫/微生物/材料机制。
scan.caution: n=51且为横断面关联，因果推断力弱。
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Tooth wear is a prevalent and multifactorial condition with consequences ranging from minor aesthetic concerns to substantial functional impairment. OBJECTIVES: The study aimed to evaluate the relationships between occlusal tactile acuity (OTA), maximum voluntary bite force and tooth wear in a clinical patient cohort. METHODS: Tooth wear, OTA and maximum bite force were assessed in 51 patients (29 women and 22 men; mean age 63 years, SD 17). Tooth wear in the anterior, canine and posterior regions was assessed with the Tooth Wear Evaluation System 2.0 in natural teeth and the Modified California Dental Association protocol in prosthetically restored teeth. Associations between OTA, bite force and tooth wear were assessed using Pearson's correlation and Spearman's rank correlation coefficients. Significant variables were entered into multivariable linear regression models and adjusted for age and sex. RESULTS: There was a moderate positive correlation between bite force and overall tooth wear (r = 0.38, p = 0.006) and a small negative correlation between OTA and posterior tooth wear (r = -0.28, p = 0.044). In the multivariable models, bite force showed a strong significant association with overall tooth wear also after adjustment for age (R2 = 0.458, p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Bite force may be a clinically relevant factor associated with accumulated tooth wear, whereas OTA was not independently associated with tooth wear. Longitudinal studies are needed to determine whether bite force can predict tooth wear progression and whether more comprehensive assessments of occlusal loading can improve risk assessment in rehabilitated dentitions.

scan.title: The Network Psychometric Properties of the Temporomandibular Joint Disorder Questionnaire Among Australian Adults
scan.title_zh: TMD问卷网络心理测量学性质研究
scan.one_line: 2423人澳大利亚成人数据用网络模型验证12项TMD问卷，最终保留9项条目信效度良好。
scan.so_what: 仅背景，问卷验证类研究非目标方法论。
scan.caution: 网络分析常用于心理测量，但对机制研究无直接启发。
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Australian adults have at least one symptom of temporomandibular joint disorder (TMD), and those who experience TMD report lower oral health-related quality of life. While a self-administered TMD questionnaire can be a valuable screening instrument for initial identification of disease/conditions, to the best of our knowledge, there are no comprehensively validated TMD questionnaires for the Australian population. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the psychometric properties of the TMD questionnaire using data imputation and novel network models. METHODS: This is a secondary analysis of data from the National Study of Adult Oral Health 2017-18. The sample included 2423 participants who responded to the 12-item TMD questionnaire. Descriptive statistics included demographic characteristics and the TMD distribution of adult Australians. The analytical steps include: (1) model estimation, (2) Unique Variable Analysis, (3) Exploratory Graph Analysis (EGA), (4) model fit, (5) criterion validity and (6) reliability. RESULTS: After removing poorly performing items, EGA revealed that a 9-item TMD questionnaire had excellent item stability, substantive network loadings and mixed but acceptable model fit (X2(12): 1045.91, CFI: 0.970, RMSEA: 0.077, 90% CI: 0.073-0.081, SRMR: 0.027). The reliability was good (α = 0.8; Ω = 0.8). Finding also supported known-groups validity by sex (Risk Ratios ranging from 1.44 to 4.43) and criterion validity according to quality of life (r = -0.26) and age (r = -0.21). CONCLUSIONS: This study provided evidence on the validity and reliability of the 9-item temporomandibular joint questionnaire for evaluating temporomandibular joint disorder among Australian Adults. The TMD questionnaire is readily available, which can be a practical measure of self-reported TMD symptoms for a population-based initial assessment or epidemiological research.
